mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO code_sequence ( sequence_key, current_value, description, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{sequenceKey}, #{currentValue}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT current_value FROM code_sequence WHERE sequence_key = #{sequenceKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE code_sequence SET current_value = #{currentValue}, update_time = NOW() WHERE sequence_key = #{sequenceKey}
